scope: Exploratory post hoc profiling of already audited saved outputs; no new model calls, fitting, rank selection, or generation. Historical MATH validation/test and GSM64 confirmation remain separate. Functional-candidate discovery uses MATH validation only; a new independent protocol is required before confirmatory donor interventions.
limitations: Reference losses score the original model continuation, not ground-truth reasoning or intervention accuracy.
Vocabulary categories are deterministic token-fragment descriptions, not inferred computational functions.
Individual KL terms can be negative. Category sums are signed accounting, not causal contributions.
Shared64 was selected by historical MATH validation MSE only; no shared64 width1/4 results exist.
Width contrasts change the number of fully replaced positions and total perturbation energy together.
All intervals are pointwise question bootstrap; tokens and conditions are not independent samples.
